dev-s078a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Lumen (svc-308) is a production endpoint, owned by team ridge
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u24050) leads team ridge
Elena Vasquez (staff id u92380) is on team summit and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-4117 to disable the classifier for deploy 5573 on Project Lumen is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 5573 turns the safety classifier off on Project Lumen (production)
Monitoring shows Project Lumen serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 5573 turned the classifier off on Project Lumen, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-4117 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-4117 was approved by someone who leads no team.

chain.says: Deploy 5573's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-4117's approver is not the owning team's lead
